name: MultiCombobox
description: Multi-select combobox with inline chips, type-to-filter dropdown, label, error, and helper text.

ariaRequirements: input role=combobox with aria-autocomplete=list, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant
selected values are removable Badge chips; Backspace removes the last
a11y.reviewedNote: Verified 2026-06-02: type-to-filter combobox — input role=combobox with aria-autocomplete=list/aria-expanded/aria-controls/aria-activedescendant, aria-labelledby; portaled role=listbox aria-multiselectable with role=option/aria-selected; chips are removable Badges, Backspace removes the last. Keyboard (ArrowUp/Down, Enter toggle, Escape, Backspace) driven and asserted by the KeyboardMultiSelect play function. Shares ComboboxField CSS (inherits the placeholder contrast fix). Default/Playground/Example/KeyboardMultiSelect pass axe with test:error; light + dark verified in Storybook.

dense: controlled multi-select combobox; selections render as removable Badge chips in the field, type-to-filter input, portaled listbox, Backspace removes the last chip; onValueChange(string[])

usage.description: MultiCombobox picks several options from a list: chosen values render as removable Badge chips inside the field, and the inline input filters the dropdown as you type. It is controlled (value: string[], onValueChange) and owns its label/error/helperText chrome. It shares field styling and dropdown mechanics with Combobox.

bestPractices.description: Always control it: keep the selected values in state and hand back the full next array from onValueChange.
Keep option labels short; each becomes a chip and long chips wrap the field awkwardly.
Tell users about Backspace-to-remove in helperText for keyboard-heavy audiences; it deletes the last chip when the filter is empty.
Cap the practical number of selections in your form validation and say so in helperText; the field grows with every chip.
Do not use it for exactly-one choice; Combobox and Select stay clearer and cheaper.
Do not repurpose the chips as free-form tag creation; values must exist in options (no create-on-enter).

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: Visible label tied to the filter input via aria-labelledby.

anatomy.name: Chips
anatomy.description: One removable Badge per selected value, rendered inside the control; remove buttons are disabled with the field.

anatomy.name: Filter input
anatomy.description: role=combobox text input with aria-autocomplete=list; typing filters options, Backspace on empty removes the last chip.

anatomy.name: Chevron
anatomy.description: Toggle button with the caret icon; opens or closes the listbox without stealing focus.

anatomy.name: Listbox
anatomy.description: Portaled role=listbox with aria-multiselectable; selected options show a check icon, empty filter state is localized.

anatomy.name: HelperText
anatomy.description: Helper or error line; error wins and sets aria-invalid plus aria-describedby.
